title: Christian Cage proves he belongs on top
summary: Christian Cage challenges Jarrett’s dominance and wins his first NWA world championship. Abyss and James Mitchell then turn his first reign into a personal fight for survival.

chapters.title: Captain Charisma wins the big one
chapters.result: Christian Cage defeats Jarrett for the NWA world championship.
chapters.context: Cage’s move to TNA produces a main-event breakthrough, replacing Jarrett as champion rather than merely joining his supporting cast.

chapters.title: Abyss takes the fight into the cage
chapters.result: Cage defeats Abyss in Six Sides of Steel to retain.
chapters.context: After threatening Cage and his family in the storyline, Abyss loses the match but attacks the champion afterward, leaving the conflict unresolved.
